identity.description: An attacker disables the Windows Firewall using netsh commands to evade network detection and allow malicious traffic. Cortex should detect the execution of netsh with specific arguments to disable the firewall.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

payload.code:
netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off
netsh advfirewall show allprofiles
netsh advfirewall firewall set rule group="file and printer sharing" new enable=No

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of netsh process with disable firewall arguments

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Firewall Disabled via Netsh
biocs.description: Detection of netsh command executed with arguments to disable Windows Firewall
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'netsh.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'advfirewall set allprofiles state off'
